name: LSEG News API
tagline: Professional financial and corporate news wire access via LSEG Data Platform
description: LSEG News API (formerly Refinitiv) delivers market-moving financial journalism, corporate announcements, and real-time news content for professional applications. Part of the LSEG/Refinitiv Data Platform, it provides structured access to news wires used in trading, compliance, and research workflows.

auth.details: OAuth2 client credentials via LSEG/Refinitiv Data Platform; access token used as Bearer authorization (confirm against current docs)

use_cases: monitor real-time news for trading signals
retrieve news stories for compliance screening
